analysis.reasonEn: ADX at 16.8 indicates weak trend formation, with -DI (30.5 vs 25.0) showing downward pressure. RSI at 45.1 is in neutral territory, lacking directional conviction. Given the 3x leveraged nature, sharp declines are a risk during volatility. Therefore, wait and see.
